blocks.text: Some problems are the same from having the same medium, for instance, because all things are an antiperistasis, but of these some are the same in genus, which have differences from belonging to other things, or from subsisting differently, e. g. why is there an echo, or why is there a reflection, and why a rainbow? for all these are the same problem in genus, (for all are reflection,) but they differ in species. Other problems differ from the medium being contained under another medium, as why does the Nile have a greater flow during the fall of the month? because the fall of the month is more winterly: but why is the fall more winterly? because the moon fails, for thus do these subsist towards each other.
